scope: Captured modern/public production components, synthetic records and local APIs; read-only public legacy verification.

focus-modern.json.provenance: Exact retained deployed SSR components and SVG markup with current full production CSS plus new owning Workspace controls and public shell style. Bootstrap/profile/records are synthetic local visual branches, not live private sessions. Document pointerdown/keydown listeners run the exact new modality script; focus is then sampled after actual pointer clicks and Tab events. No form submissions, messages or API writes.
